text:
carla: Heads-up — Acme Health POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Quick thread to confirm prep: stakeholders, security questionnaire status, pricing guardrails, and success criteria.

jordan: I can run the tech demo and the latency/cost evals. Do we have sample prompts + dataset?

maya: I uploaded a stripped-down prompts.csv to the sales drive (link in DM). Need confirmation on PHI handling — customer said they will provide de-identified samples.

carla: @maya great. @elena can you confirm SOC2 docs + any outstanding items in their security questionnaire? They asked about SSO and KMS.

elena: SOC2 report is in the folder. Customer also wants SSO via SAML and BYOK/HSM support. I flagged the KMS playbook.

tim: For pricing: Acme expects an estimate for a 4-week POC (50k tokens/day average). We'll propose hosted trial credits + a committed Dedicated quote if they want predictable throughput. Any constraints on showing a committed pricing number during kickoff?

jordan: Suggest we show two options: (1) hosted POC pricing + uplift for optional burst capacity, (2) provisional Dedicated ballpark (monthly commit). Keep the Dedicated quote marked preliminary.

carla: Success criteria — they asked for quality (F1 >= 0.72 on entity extraction eval), latency (p95 < 250ms for 512-token requests), and cost target (<$0.003/token effective). Are those feasible?

maya: Quality target: okay with our medium Llama variant + prompt engineering. Latency looks fine on an rtx-a10x pool with batching tuned. Cost target depends on quantization — we should recommend int8 and caching for repeated customer prefixes.

carla: Action items before kickoff: 1) @jordan prepare short perf deck + notebook run showing expected p95 and cost for their sample prompts. 2) @maya prepare eval harness and the example prompt set (include negative cases). 3) @elena confirm SSO/KMS path and upload signed NDA if needed. 4) Sales to share a one-pager for pricing options.

jordan: I'll attach a short `run.sh` snippet for the perf test during the call:```
export REDWOOD_KEY=REDACTED
python perf_eval.py --model redwood-medium --batch-size 8 --seq-len 512 --samples 200
```

maya: Also recommend we ask Acme for 3 canonical success prompts during kickoff and a sample throughput spike scenario (eg 10x bursts for 2 hours). I'll add that to the agenda.

carla: Agenda for tomorrow (10am PT): intros (5m), goals & success criteria (10m), security/Q&A (10m), demo + perf run (20m), pricing & timelines (10m), next steps (5m). Please be ready to call out blockers.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite sent to attendees and a Zoom link was created.

elena: One more note — procurement may need a PoC statement of work for their legal team. I can draft a short SOW (1 page) and share before EOD.

carla: Perfect. If anyone has any blocker, drop it here now. Otherwise see you all tomorrow. :thumbsup:
